# Example data

These public UQ ELECEX2350 course tables are a historical local example snapshot. The exact retrieval date was not recorded; they are not a current catalogue or a student record. Course names and prerequisite descriptions originate from https://programs-courses.uq.edu.au/. `courses.csv` contains captured metadata, `gallery_courses.csv` its course-code/name projection, and `prereq_edges.csv` the earlier parsed example relationships. The current conservative parser may flag more rows than that earlier snapshot because bare commas now require review. Generated demonstration statuses are illustrative.

`demo_courses.csv` is a deliberately synthetic four-course tutorial. Its names and relationships are illustrative and must not be used as UQ enrolment rules.
